body.en:
Question B-005-012-004.

Why the correct answer is right: A tuned circuit needs an inductor and a capacitor. Energy trades between the magnetic field and electric field at the resonant frequency.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Resistor and transistor": These parts can set gain or bias, but they do not form the basic inductor-capacitor (LC) tuned circuit.
- sourceIndex 2: "Capacitor and resistor": A resistor-capacitor (RC) network can filter, but without an inductor it is not the basic resonant tuned circuit.
- sourceIndex 3: "Diode and transistor": Semiconductor devices can be used around tuned stages. They are not the two energy-storage parts that make the tuned circuit.
